efficacy_outcome: At 12 weeks, the high-protein diet plus beta-cryptoxanthin group had greater reductions than control in ALT, AST, alkaline phosphatase, and GGT (mean differences −27.2, −7.2, −39.2, and −16.3 IU/L; all p<0.010). Grade 0 steatosis remission was 82.6% versus 0.0% in control (p<0.001).
safety_signal: Sixteen patients reported minor adverse events; event details were not reported.
